summary: Anonymous Mongol-language chronicle of Temüjin's rise, the only account in Mongolian.
bias_notes: Celebrates the Chinggisid line; epic and literary in style (patron-bias).
title: The Secret History of the Mongols
reliability_notes: Written within the ruling family's circle; exact date debated. Doc access: via May (GK-S09) and excerpts. Rashid al-Din (GK-S03) drew on some of the same Mongol material.
